study.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-26. Blood-culture methods comparison (BHI broth vs Isolator lysis-centrifugation vs pour plate) in suspected severe melioidosis. TTP reported as method-level median; mortality reported by quantitative count categories and by BC-positive vs BC-negative. No quantitative TTP-vs-outcome model; only narrative/methods linkage. Funded by Wellcome Trust. Patients enrolled in parallel RCT of ceftazidime vs imipenem.

population.empiric_abx_definition: All patients started on ceftazidime or imipenem appropriate for severe melioidosis (per parallel RCT protocol)
population.incubation_protocol: Manual BHI broth (Difco/BCB Vent/Sub), unshaken in air at 37C for 7 days; subcultured at 12-24h and 36-48h. Parallel Isolator 10 lysis centrifugation and pour plate (Columbia agar).
population.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Adults (>15y) with suspected severe melioidosis admitted to Sappasitprasong Hospital, Ubon Ratchathani. 82 enrolled, 71 confirmed melioidosis, 42 BC-positive (septicaemic). Age/sex distribution not reported in this paper.

ttp.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Primary TTP reported here is for BHI broth (n=42 BC-positive, median 61.8h, mean 78.9 +/- 51.2, range 35-205.5h). Comparative method TTP medians: Isolator 39.3h (n=34, mean 37.2 +/- 11.7, range 16-64.5), pour plate 45.5h (n=25, mean 45.5 +/- 12.8, range 16-91.5). Inverse correlation between quantitative bacterial counts and TTP (Isolator r=-0.44 p=0.01; pour plate r=-0.57 p=0.003). No formal TTP-vs-outcome model; mortality stratified by colony count categories (table 2).

outcomes.outcome_definition: In-hospital mortality; 26/42 (61.9%) in BC-positive (septicaemic) patients vs 5/29 (17.2%) in BC-negative (p<0.001). Overall melioidosis cohort 31/71 (43.7%). Mortality higher with higher bacterial counts (Isolator counts >=10 cfu/ml p=0.015). Not stratified by TTP.
outcomes.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Mortality reported but not stratified by TTP. Crude count-mortality data available in table 2 but TTP-mortality 2x2 not constructible from reported tables (counts and TTP shown for different stratifications).

study.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] [CONTAMINATED_TTP - used as CRBSI definition criterion] Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-26. Pediatric (2-12y) long-term hemodialysis CVC cohort, single Sri Lankan tertiary center. DTP used categorically to classify CLABSI (DTP >=2h) vs bacteremia-without-CLABSI vs colonization, per CDC definitions; therefore TTP is part of the exposure-definition pipeline. Outcome data are infectious complications (RS-IE, sepsis, septic shock) rather than mortality. No quantitative TTP-vs-outcome model; multivariable model targets asymptomatic vs symptomatic CLABSI, not mortality. Population n=1462 children. Reported author order: Jayaweera J.A.A.S. & Sivakumar D.; first author = Jayaweera.

population.pathogen_species: Mixed: MSSA, MRSA, CoNS (S. epidermidis predominant), Klebsiella pneumoniae, E. coli, P. aeruginosa, Citrobacter, Enterococcus spp., Candida albicans, C. parapsilosis, C. tropicalis
population.empiric_abx_definition: Not formally defined; receipt of vancomycin/meropenem/linezolid in prior 5 days analyzed as risk factor for asymptomatic CLABSI
population.incubation_protocol: BACTEC semi-automated platform; paired CVC and peripheral cultures at each HD session; DTP threshold per CDC criteria (paired same-volume sampling).
population.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Pediatric-only cohort on long-term hemodialysis with indwelling CVC, 2-year follow-up. 1090/1462 (74.5%) BC-positive: 410 (28%) CLABSI by DTP, 520 (35.6%) bacteremia without CLABSI, 160 (11%) colonizers, 372 (25.4%) culture-negative.

ttp.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] [CONTAMINATED_TTP] DTP used dichotomously per CDC CLABSI definition (CVC culture positive >=2h before peripheral). n_short_ttp (DTP >=2h, CLABSI) = 410; n_long_ttp (paired positive without DTP >=2h, bacteremia-without-CLABSI) = 520. Continuous TTP values not reported.

outcomes.outcome_definition: Right-sided infective endocarditis (RS-IE) on serial 2D-echo. 122/1462 (8.3%) overall; in CLABSI: 72 (symptomatic 30 + asymptomatic 42); in bacteremia-without-CLABSI: 50 (symptomatic 14 + asymptomatic 36). RS-IE significantly associated with asymptomatic CLABSI and asymptomatic bacteremia.
outcomes.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] [CONTAMINATED_TTP] Descriptive 2x2: RS-IE 72/410 (17.6%) in CLABSI (DTP>=2h) vs 50/520 (9.6%) in bacteremia-without-CLABSI. Mortality not reported. Sepsis/septic shock prevalence 58/410 (17.5%) symptomatic CLABSI and 68/398 (17.1%) symptomatic bacteremia.

study.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-26. Single 971-bed US community hospital. Comparison of T2 Candida Panel (T2CP) vs conventional blood culture (BC) for candidemia detection. Time-to-detection (TTD) is the exposure but defined per-diagnostic-method rather than per-pathogen growth; thus the TTP-to-outcome contrast is confounded by test type. Multivariable mortality regression did NOT include TTP/TTD as a predictor — only renal failure/age/CCI/gender. No quantitative TTP-vs-mortality association reported; descriptive 2x2 by detection-method group is derivable.

population.empiric_abx_definition: Initial antifungal administered prior to diagnostic test resulting; 60.7% in T2CP group, 14.4% in BC group
population.incubation_protocol: Conventional BC plus T2 Candida Panel (PCR-based magnetic resonance); single-center practice, T2CP restricted to ID/heme-onc providers from Sept 2015.
population.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Adults with positive BC (n=163) or T2CP (n=89) for Candida spp. Median age 60 (T2CP) and 61 (BC); ~53% male overall (T2CP 46.1%, BC 57.1%). Median CCI 4 (T2CP) vs 5 (BC). ICU admission 67.4% T2CP vs 56.4% BC.

ttp.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] TTP reported here is for the conventional BC arm (median 41h, IQR 29-60). T2CP arm median time-to-detection 9h (IQR 6-17), p<0.001 vs BC. Categorization is by diagnostic method (T2CP rapid PCR vs conventional BC), not by intra-method TTP cut. ttp_cutpoint_hours left null because the split is not a numeric TTP threshold.

outcomes.outcome_definition: 30-day all-cause mortality. T2CP group 33/89 (37.1%) vs BC group 51/163 (31.3%), p=0.351.
outcomes.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Descriptive 2x2 by detection method (T2CP=short TTD vs BC=long TTD); not a within-method TTP split. Multivariable mortality model did not include TTP.

outcomes.outcome_definition: In-hospital mortality. T2CP 29/89 (32.6%) vs BC 47/163 (28.8%), p=0.535.
outcomes.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Descriptive 2x2 by detection method (T2CP vs BC).

study.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-26. National French RESSIF prospective surveillance registry of mold-positive blood cultures from 30 university teaching hospitals, 2012-2022. After excluding pseudofungemia (modified Duthie-Denning criteria) and incomplete reports: 80 episodes analyzed. Firth multivariable logistic regression for day-90 mortality included genus, corticosteroid exposure, age, organ involvement — but NOT TTP. TTP reported descriptively by mold genus.

population.pathogen_species: Mold fungemia: Fusarium spp 67.5% (FFSC 36%, Neocosmospora 15%, FOSC 11%, Bisifusarium 3.8%), Lomentospora prolificans 10%, Trichoderma spp 5%, Mucorales 5%, Aspergillus spp 5%, other 7.5%
population.empiric_abx_definition: Antifungal preexposition (>=5 days within prior 30 days) in 41% (33/80); breakdown: echinocandin 14%, posaconazole 16%, L-AmB 8.8%, voriconazole 7.5%
population.incubation_protocol: Standard blood culture across 30 centers; 6 samples required >5d incubation. Time-to-positivity collected from participating labs.
population.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] 74/80 (93%) had CVC; 66/74 (89%) underwent CVC removal. Hematological malignancy in 70% (allo-HSCT 43%); gastrointestinal condition 13%; solid organ transplant 5%. Neutropenia 49%. Corticosteroid exposure 23%.

ttp.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Overall median TTP 72h (IQR 52.3-90). By genus: Fusarium 76.9h (61-94), L. prolificans 62.7h (56.4-66), Trichoderma 65.1h (60.4-68.6), Mucorales 38.4h (37.6-40), Aspergillus 63.0h (47-100), other 120h (73-131). Difference between molds p=0.038. No formal TTP-vs-mortality model.

outcomes.outcome_definition: Day-90 all-cause mortality: 41/80 (53%) overall. By genus: Fusarium 43%, L. prolificans 100%, Trichoderma 50%, Mucorales 75%, Aspergillus 100%, other 17%. Multivariable Firth logistic regression (adjusted for genus, corticosteroids, organ involvement, etc.) identified L. prolificans aOR 33.3 (3.52-4456), Aspergillus aOR 14.2 (1.25-2006), corticosteroids aOR 7.85 (1.64-37.6). TTP not in model.
outcomes.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Overall 90-day mortality 41/80 (53%). Genus with shortest TTP (Mucorales 38.4h) had high mortality (75%), genus with longest TTP (other molds 120h) had low mortality (17%) — paradoxical descriptive pattern likely confounded by pathogen virulence and host factors. TTP not tested in multivariable model. 2x2 by TTP not directly computable.

study.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] [POTENTIAL_DUPLICATE_OF_Wong2016_b] Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-26. Wong2016_b (BMC Infect Dis n=400) is the expanded cohort from the same two Vancouver tertiary hospitals (VGH, St Paul's), same authors, same 2007-2014 period, same MSSA-bacteremia inclusion. Wong2016_a (Ann Clin Microbiol Antimicrob n=255) is the earlier/smaller publication. TTP reported only as median+IQR baseline characteristic stratified by empiric beta-lactam vs vancomycin (not stratified by mortality outcome). Multivariable adjustment used (age, age-adjusted CCI, ID consult, IE, time to empiric abx) but TTP not in mortality model. No quantitative TTP-vs-mortality association published.

population.empiric_abx_definition: Beta-lactam group (n=131) received cloxacillin/cefazolin/BL-BLI/3GC/carbapenem +/- vancomycin; vancomycin group (n=124) received vancomycin alone before susceptibilities returned. All received definitive cloxacillin or cefazolin.
population.incubation_protocol: Standard practice at two Vancouver tertiary hospitals; TTP captured from microbiology LIMS as time from BC collection to positivity flag.
population.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] [POTENTIAL_DUPLICATE_OF_Wong2016_b] First MSSA bacteremia episode in adults (>=18y). Beta-lactam group: mean age 53.2 +/- 16.5, vancomycin group 59.4 +/- 18.3 (p=0.005). Overall 66.3% male. 74.1% community-onset. Median CCI 3 vs 4. Infective endocarditis in 14.1%. Source: unknown 27.1%, SSTI 18.4%, line 16.5%, IDU 15.7%.

ttp.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] [POTENTIAL_DUPLICATE_OF_Wong2016_b] TTP reported as baseline characteristic by treatment arm: beta-lactam median 20.0h (IQR 16.5-24.9), vancomycin median 18.3h (15.9-23.5), p=0.17. Cohort-wide median estimated by midpoint; only arm-specific values are reported in paper. No TTP cutpoint; not stratified by mortality.

outcomes.outcome_definition: 28-day all-cause mortality. Overall 18/255 (7.06%). Beta-lactam 7/131 (5.3%) vs vancomycin 11/124 (8.9%), p=0.27. Adjusted OR 0.85 (95% CI 0.27-2.67) beta-lactam vs vancomycin (adjusted for age, age-adjusted Charlson, ID consult, IE, time to empiric).
outcomes.adjustment_vars: age; age-adjusted Charlson comorbidity index; ID consultation; infective endocarditis; time to receipt of empiric antibiotics
outcomes.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] [POTENTIAL_DUPLICATE_OF_Wong2016_b] Effect estimate is for empiric beta-lactam vs vancomycin, NOT for TTP. TTP not in mortality model. 2x2 by TTP not derivable from published tables.

outcomes.outcome_definition: 90-day all-cause mortality. Overall 36/255 (14.1%). Beta-lactam 14/131 (10.7%) vs vancomycin 22/124 (17.7%), p=0.11. Adjusted OR 0.88 (95% CI 0.36-2.17).
outcomes.adjustment_vars: age; age-adjusted Charlson comorbidity index; ID consultation; infective endocarditis; time to receipt of empiric antibiotics
outcomes.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] [POTENTIAL_DUPLICATE_OF_Wong2016_b] Effect is empiric treatment contrast, not TTP.

outcomes.outcome_definition: Duration of bacteremia (time from first positive to first negative BC). Beta-lactam median 70.7h (IQR 46.9-119) vs vancomycin 97.1h (61.6-148), p=0.007. >=3 days: 58/116 (50%) vs 72/114 (63.2%), p=0.047. Adjusted ratio of means 0.77 (0.62-0.95) favoring beta-lactam.
outcomes.adjustment_vars: age; age-adjusted Charlson; ID consult; IE; time to empiric abx; surgical source control
outcomes.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] [POTENTIAL_DUPLICATE_OF_Wong2016_b] Effect is empiric treatment contrast. 25 patients (15 beta-lactam, 10 vancomycin) excluded for lack of follow-up cultures.
